思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S11 「现成的 spec：Regenerate 给新记录请求一个新的建议」 Existing spec: Regenerate requests a fresh suggestion for the new note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital patient with a generated note and its billing

When The note is regenerated (new noteGeneratedAt and text)

Then A second billing request carries the new note; the saved billing belongs to the new note

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in billing-suggestion.spec.ts: two suggestBilling calls, the second with the regenerated note; billingForNoteAt = the second generatedAt. Whether Regenerate should re-bill at all is Q4.
